<?php
// Smoke-suite fixture: keep TEC's first-run onboarding out of wp-admin.
// Options written by the blueprint don't survive TEC's own first bootstrap on
// Playground, so the Guided Setup redirect / wizard modal would hijack whichever
// TEC admin screen a test happens to load first. Filters hold on every request.
add_filter( 'tribe_get_option_tec_onboarding_wizard_visited_guided_setup', '__return_true' );
add_filter( 'tribe_get_option_tec_events_onboarding_page_dismissed', '__return_true' );
add_filter( 'pre_option_tec_onboarding_wizard_data', function () { return [ 'finished' => true ]; } );

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; if ( ! function_exists('tribe_events') ) { return; } $ev = tribe_events()->set_args([ 'title'=>'Weekly Service', 'status'=>'publish', 'start_date'=>date('Y-m-d 19:00:00', strtotime('+7 days')), 'end_date'=>date('Y-m-d 20:30:00', strtotime('+7 days')), 'timezone'=>'America/New_York' ])->create(); flush_rewrite_rules();
